text:
ravi: Proposal: adaptive hedge budget at the gateway based on a moving window of token progress rather than a fixed ms timer. If progress falls below X tokens/sec for Y ms, count toward a per-request retry budget.
claire: Curious: how do we get token progress? upstream trailer header? heartbeat frames?
ravi: prefer lightweight header/trailer `x-rw-token-progress: idx=NN` when available, fallback to bytes/keepalives. Gateway computes tokens/sec over last K tokens.
matt: sounds reasonable but must respect side-effects. For idempotent routes allow hedging; otherwise block. Route config flags: `idempotent=true|false`, `hedge_budget=nn`.
kevin: Billing: if hedged replicas both produce output, gateway should de-dup in-flight by request-id and token-range and only bill accepted tokens. Implement small dedupe cache with TTL 2s for short requests. Flag long streams as no-hedge.
ravi: algorithm sketch: maintain sliding window W (default 500ms) compute token_rate; if token_rate < threshold AND no `x-rw-final=true`, mark as stalled. consume 1 unit from hedge_budget and launch hedged call.
claire: operational metrics to add: `edge.hedge_budget_remaining`, `edge.hedge_triggers_by_route`, `edge.token_rate_p50/p95`. Also emit event when we deny hedge due to route non-idempotency.
matt: dedupe state memory can blow up. limit hedging to requests with expected tokens < 4000 or duration < 15s. Longer streams require explicit opt-in.
kevin: tracing: add `edge.hedge` span and `hedge.outcome=accepted|discarded|both` so billing can reconcile.
ops-bot: feature-flag: edge.adaptive-hedging enabled for canary 3% at 2024-07-02T08:00:00Z
ravi: rollout plan: feature flag -> canary 3% -> 20% -> 100% with cost/correctness checks. We'll include synthetic tests: slow-start (no first token), midstream stalls, noisy throughput.
claire: one more: SDKs should not need to act but can expose progress to apps via optional callback if they want to present spinner vs fallback UI.
matt: add failure mode doc: dedupe cache eviction could accept later primary -> ensure monotonic token index and accept highest progress.
kevin: +1. please include concrete thresholds and a small sim harness in RFC.
ravi: I'll draft RFC, include compatibility notes for http/1 chunked, http2 frames, and websockets. Ping when draft ready.
